mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper directly measures peptide-antibiotic interaction phenotypes by checkerboard FIC assays; this supports synergy/indifference calls, not a direct molecular mechanism for each peptide.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: short AMPs tested against MDR P. aeruginosa PA910 and selected strains

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The discussion attributes polymyxin B synergy context to LPS/lipid A binding and membrane permeability effects from prior literature; this is mechanistic context, not a new direct mechanism assay in this paper.

The discussion links indolicidin/variants to previously reported effects on ATP-dependent enzymes and DNA/RNA/protein synthesis; the current paper uses these as explanatory context for observed synergy patterns.

limitations: No direct membrane, enzyme, transcript, or protein-synthesis mechanism assay is newly performed in this paper; mechanism ontology must remain phenotypic/contextual rather than direct_mechanism.
